title: Jets OC Frank Reich defends fourth down run; "Comfortable and confident in my play calls"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jets OC Frank Reich defends fourth down run; "Comfortable and confident in my play calls"
sources.description: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn took a lot of heat for his clock management after the team's 20-17 overtime loss to the Packers last Sunday, but it wasn't the only coaching decision to come under scrutiny.
